editorial.blurb: A spacious neighborhood brewery and kitchen where craft beers—especially their German and Czech-inspired brews—shine alongside solid American comfort food in a welcoming, lively atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during happy hour for solid deals, and don't miss their rotating beer selection; ask your server about brewery tours and check their calendar for trivia nights and live music.
signatureDishes: Chicken Wings with Mango and Habanero Sauce
